patch.value: Observable real-time collaboration with privacy-safe logs and live counters

Companion pm-cli-website-8kqg. Add structured request and SSE lifecycle logs, watcher sweep instrumentation, aggregate health counters and stale watcher degradation. Prove a separate pm process write reaches a real SSE subscriber and prove stdout excludes request secrets and content.
External shared-project writes reach SSE in a bounded real-server test; lifecycle counters are operator-visible; logs contain no request secrets or content.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Duplicate search found historical delivery proofs but no active observability item. Companion: pm-cli-website-8kqg. Plan: aggregate process-local health counters with freshness checked on every request, HMAC pseudonyms, safe route templates, lifecycle and sweep logs, real PostgreSQL and temp-root SSE proof plus behavioural link-break verification. Hosted services and telemetry configuration remain outside this work.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented JSON stdout logs, registered route templates, HMAC user/project pseudonyms, and aggregate process-local health counters. Three missed filesystem sweep intervals (45 seconds by default), disabled sweeps or last-tick errors degrade health; freshness is read after cached dependency probes. Existing HTTP error log sites also use sanitized structured diagnostics to avoid leaking request-derived values. Focused new real-server and watchdog/privacy tests passed 8/8; delivery requires filesystem-origin SSE and uses a separate pinned pm process.

All mutations restored. Focused instrumentation, real-server and idempotency suites passed 34/34 with zero fail, skip, cancel or todo. The linked 8/8 tests passed via pm test --run --progress; this tracker has result recording disabled, so outcomes are recorded here.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Finding 1 VALID/FIXED: fatalError now waits for the stdout write callback after sanitized logError before exit(1). Real child-process tests pipe stdout with 2 MiB queued ahead of the fatal JSON and exercise both uncaughtException and unhandledRejection. Behavioural revert: reverting only fatalError to immediate process.exit(1), then node scripts/with-test-db.ts node --test --test-name-pattern="fatal JSON" test/observability.test.ts, produced 0 pass / 2 fail / 0 skip, both failing "fatal JSON line must finish". Restored the callback fix.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Finding 2 VALID/FIXED: same-id SSE replacement ends the prior response, logs a sanitized close error if needed, and removes the prior registration in finally; presence is scheduled for its former project. Tests check close attempts, both project indexes, current gauge, connection/disconnection totals, late old unsubscribe safety and delivery to the replacement, including a throwing end(). Behavioural revert: reverting only addSSEClient replacement to removeClient(previous, "replaced"), then node --test --test-name-pattern="replacing an SSE client" test/sse.test.ts, produced 0 pass / 2 fail / 0 skip; both observed zero closes instead of one. Restored the fix.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Finding 3 VALID/FIXED: setLogLevel sets explicit error/info thresholds and restores the original value (including absence) via test cleanup. All three cited observability tests and the PostgreSQL persistence-error test use it. Behavioural revert: replacing only setLogLevel body with a no-op, then env LOG_LEVEL=silent node scripts/with-test-db.ts node --test --test-name-pattern="unknown errors|filesystem sweep errors|health requests|PostgreSQL outcome-write" test/observability.test.ts test/idempotency.test.ts, produced 0 pass / 4 fail / 0 skip due to suppressed error, watcher, request and persistence events. Restored the helper; all other fixes remained applied during each isolated revert.
